Maverick Browser

A tab for your agent

Start here. Your agent can choose profiles, posts, searches and videos across Instagram, X, Reddit, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.

  1. Click Maverick Browser Companion in Chrome’s extension toolbar on this tab.
  2. Choose Connect agent tab once and allow access when Chrome asks. The Maverick address is already configured.
  3. Sign in to Maverick if asked. The connection starts automatically. Keep both this tab and Maverick open.

The agent navigates this tab. Companion reuses an existing Maverick tab in the same Chrome profile; a separate window is needed when Maverick is open in a desktop app or another browser. For other installations, change the Maverick address in Companion’s Connection settings.

Then ask Maverick what to research. The agent can navigate, read, scroll and analyze images, video and audio in this tab.

Use your usual Chrome profile and sign in to the platforms in Chrome. Posting, messaging and form entry are not available. Your other tabs are not shared.
